sloka: तस्य पुत्रो मिथिः नाम जनको मिथि पुत्रकः ।प्रथमो जनको नाम जनकात् अपि उदावसुः ॥१-७१-४॥
transliteration: tasya putro mithiḥ nāma janako mithi putrakaḥ ।prathamo janako nāma janakāt api udāvasuḥ ॥1-71-4॥

translations.english: Nimi begot a son named Mithi who constructed Mithila. He was the first Janaka whose son was Udavasu.
